items.correct: Rural-to-urban migration for jobs and services, plus natural increase.
items.misconception: Only higher birth rates inside cities.
items.random_wrong: People moving from cities to the countryside.
items.why: Urbanisation is largely people moving to cities seeking work and better services.

items.q: Where is population generally growing fastest?
items.random_wrong: Population can only ever increase everywhere.
items.why: Richer countries often have low or negative natural growth; poorer ones tend to grow faster.
